review.evidence: Awaiting independent S review at this HEAD: ADR 0016/0017 + PH-312 alignment (append-only run pair, current-state updates only, no core schema, no business fact writes), command semantics (company lock, expected_version, DeliveryReceipt idempotency, dry_run zero writes, closing+closed pair, reopen chain), precheck reuse of owner read services with frozen issue codes/reminder refs/precheck digest, permissions/module gating, UI history_read/business_write split, verifier five branches and probes, append-only vendor-aware guards, and the exact whitelist/planning-slot gap. projectctl check, manage.py check, makemigrations, verify_integrity and scoped tests pass; full suite has the known macOS failures plus the out-of-whitelist query-count threshold failure; verify-change is expected red until PH-336. No worker self-attested pass is recorded.

deviations: BASE whitelist gap (explicitly disclosed): PH-322 is still proposed on BASE 987ec1e and its allowed_paths do not include pmo_plugins/delivery/models.py, pmo_plugins/delivery/migrations/* or core/management/commands/verify_integrity.py, although PH-312 §9.2 requires them. Implementation proceeded per Lead decision; PH-336 planning slot will expand the whitelist, after which this branch must be rebased and verify-change re-run.

Full suite adds one out-of-whitelist failure: tests/test_v1_cash_book_bridge.py's verifier query-count ceiling (84) is exceeded by 4 fixed close-verification queries (88). The test file is outside the PH-322 whitelist; the planning slot should bump the threshold (e.g. 92) as done for earlier verifier branches (PH-269/PH-274 precedent).

closing is a transactional phase, not a durable observable state: the committed history contains the pair closing(n)+closed(n+1); reads/verifier treat a dangling closing as corruption. This follows PH-312's frozen decision B and does not add a closing branch to owner period/project checks.

Period precheck/project precheck reuse existing owner read services with conservative issue-code mapping; unsupported read sources are reported as missing (not as 0) and no second reconciliation rule is created. Cash bank issues are read via bank_account_issues dict issue_count, not treated as a list.

request_token idempotency uses DeliveryReceipt (action/digest/result_id); run request_token is stored only on the first (closing/reopened) row and is null on the paired closed row, matching the frozen PH-312 model constraint.

No core model/migration is changed; only existing AccountingPeriod.status/closed_through and Project.stage/previous_stage current rows are updated in the same transaction as the run pair and audit/receipt.
No automatic correction, export, notification push, PAT/MCP close tool or customer portal is added; no business fact is written by close/reopen.
